turns.customer: The Glowworm headlamp from order #1050 arrived with a cracked lens and won't turn on.
turns.reply: Sorry the headlamp arrived in that shape. You reported it well within 14 days of delivery, so I've issued a refund of $29.00 to your original payment method. There's no need to send the item back unless a team member asks. Thanks for understanding.
